note: The bands the Slow Stick plant has to land in, from docs/SLOWSTICK-STAGE1.md, which derives each from published figures for the GWS Slow Stick, GWS's power table and the drawn model (scripts/slowstick-derive.js prints the derived figures). Each band is the Cub's in proportion about its derived figure unless its source says otherwise. Never widened to pass; argue in the derivation instead.

s1_level_75.source: level speed at 75 percent throttle, derived 7.41: the Slow Stick's cruise. Re-derived 2026-10-11 on the prop curve FW_SLOWSTICK1180 carries (APC's stand in for GWS's 11 x 8; prop curves, w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e, scripts/slowstick-derive.js through scripts/lib/propcurve.js): was 5.58 on the straight line, which under-read the thrust at speed; the band the same 0.860 to 1.165 of the derived (was 4.8 to 6.5) Re-derived 2026-10-11 with the prop at the motor law's speed for the stick (propcurve.js electricN, 0.776 at 0.75; the derivation had taken the stick for the speed): derived 7.41 to 7.73, the band in the same proportion, was 6.37 to 8.63.

s2_stall.source: sqrt(2W / rho S CLmax), derived 4.43; alphaStall is CLmax / CLalpha, 1.05 / 4.58, of the zero lift line Re-derived 2026-10-11: alphaStall over the wing's own slope, a_w 4.268 (scripts/slowstick-derive.js), not the wing and tail's 4.58: the stall angle is the wing's and the tail's share lifts on past it, as the Extra's (#935); was 0.22925764192139736. And the band with it: the plant's CLmax is the wing's 1.050 plus the tail's share at that angle, (CLa - a_w) sin a cos a = 0.074, so the formula's speeds go by sqrt(1.050 / 1.124) = 0.9667.

s4_top.source: level speed at full throttle, derived 10.28. Re-derived 2026-10-11 on the prop curve FW_SLOWSTICK1180 carries (APC's stand in for GWS's 11 x 8; prop curves, w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e, scripts/slowstick-derive.js through scripts/lib/propcurve.js): was 8.37; the band the same 0.908 to 1.123 of the derived (was 7.6 to 9.4)

s5_climb.source: full throttle, best over a sweep of airspeeds, derived 2.18 at 6.2 m/s. Re-derived 2026-10-11 on the prop curve FW_SLOWSTICK1180 carries (APC's stand in for GWS's 11 x 8; prop curves, w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e, scripts/slowstick-derive.js through scripts/lib/propcurve.js): was 1.17 at 5.0 m/s; the band the same 0.684 to 1.197 of the derived (was 0.8 to 1.4), the sweep moved with the best climb speed it brackets (was 4.8 to 6.0)

s6_self_level.source: from a 30 deg bank at cruise, every stick centred: the flown model (scripts/slowstick-derive.js bankAfterFlown: the longitudinal model alongside the lateral one, the body pitch rate a turn carries, the fin's terms in the prop's wash, the prop's torque and swirl, and the bank's rate phi' = p + tan(theta) (q sin(phi) + r cos(phi)), Etkin and Reid ch. 4) gives 18.4, 15.9 and 13.1 deg after 2, 4 and 6 s, slowing to 6.03 m/s. Each checkpoint is held to the derived curve within 1.6 deg: the model tracks the plant within 0.8 deg at all three (19.2, 16.1, 13.0 at 6.04 m/s on w35-prop-ctj 3147cd29c), and the same again is the margin for the linear lateral model against the plant's nonlinear one; the same side throughout, never steeper than 32 deg. Re-based 2026-10-11 from one bank at 6 s within 0.465 to 1.55 of the derived (6.09 to 20.3 deg), set when the derivation was a constant speed model, to all three checkpoints against the curve: a tighter test, since the derivation now tracks the plant.

s7_rudder_bank.source: full right roll stick, which is full right rudder, from level cruise: 46.2 deg after 1 s by the lateral model, right wing down. Re-derived 2026-10-11 on the prop curve FW_SLOWSTICK1180 carries (APC's stand in for GWS's 11 x 8; prop curves, w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e, scripts/slowstick-derive.js through scripts/lib/propcurve.js): at the 7.41 m/s cruise, was 32.9 deg at 5.58 m/s; the band the same 0.61 to 1.52 of the derived (was 20 to 50) Re-derived 2026-10-11 with the prop at the motor law's speed for the stick (propcurve.js electricN, 0.776 at 0.75; the derivation had taken the stick for the speed): derived 46.2 to 48.8, the band in the same proportion, was 28.0 to 70.0.

s8_turn.source: a level 45 deg bank held on the rudder at 90 percent: the radius against V^2 / (g tan bank) at the bank and speed flown, the Cub's 15 percent, and the radius itself against the 8.09 m the level turn flies at 8.91 m/s with 2.3 deg of up elevator, the turn's pitch damping included, within the same 15 percent. Re-derived 2026-10-11 on the prop curve FW_SLOWSTICK1180 carries (APC's stand in for GWS's 11 x 8; prop curves, w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e, scripts/slowstick-derive.js through scripts/lib/propcurve.js): was 4.66 m at 6.76 m/s with 6.9 deg, when 75 percent would not hold a level 45 deg bank; on the curve 75 percent holds one at 6.79 m/s, and the gate keeps the 90 percent it was written for Re-derived 2026-10-11 with the prop at the motor law's speed for the stick (propcurve.js electricN, 0.776 at 0.75; the derivation had taken the stick for the speed): derived 8.085 to 8.36, the band in the same proportion, was 6.87 to 9.3.

s9_stall_power_off.source: Entered 2026-10-11 as FAA-H-8083-3C ch. 5 Full Stalls, Power-Off sets it up, a stabilised idle descent at the normal approach speed, 1.3 times the middle of S2's band, then full up (scripts/*-gates.js S9a quotes it); was entered from cruise, which the prop curves raised by a fifth. Re-derived 2026-10-11 on scripts/lib/liftcurve.js brought up to the plant's sourced model (the wing stalling on its own slope a_w, the tail's share lifting on past it, the finite wing's broadside normal force 1.11 + 0.018 AR of Viterna and Janetzke NASA TM-82944 with B2, where it had the whole aircraft's slope and the infinite plate's 2.0): the full up mush at 16.8 deg, 4.44 m/s sinking 0.743 (was 16.0 deg, 4.63 m/s, 0.923), within 25 percent (was 0.69 to 1.15). full up from cruise, throttle closed, held 8 s: the pitching moment, taken back through the stall, trims at 16.0 deg of alpha and the aircraft settles into a mush at 4.63 m/s sinking 0.92 m/s, within 25 percent; no wing drop, no yaw that is a spin (a spin at this size turns at over 90 deg/s), the nose never plunging. Re-derived 2026-10-08 on the plant's curve with CL max at its top and the stalled centre of pressure moving aft from the stall (docs/FLIGHTMODEL.md, scripts/lib/liftcurve.js): the first derivation took the flat plate past the stall, 17.9 deg, 5.7 m/s, 2.09 m/s The yaw limit is re-derived 2026-10-11 from a spin's definition, autorotation: with the wings inside the bank limit the aircraft only turns, at g tan(bank) / V, so the limit is the turn that bank allows at the mush's speed (31 to 32 deg/s here), where it was 20 deg/s with no source (scripts/slowstick-gates.js S9, docs/FLIGHTMODEL.md).

s9_stall_power_on.source: re-derived 2026-10-11 to FAA-H-8083-3C ch. 5, Full Stalls, Power-On, quoted in wingpilot.js faaPowerOnStall: held coordinated on the rudder until the stall, recognised and recovered (elevator neutral, wings on the rudder, power kept), never on its back, the wings level within the bank limit by the time the speed is back and held (the handbook returns to the flightpath with sufficient airspeed); was: full up held for the whole run with the wings within 15 deg on the rudder, the prolonged stalled condition the handbook says to prevent, which past the stall a rudder cannot hold since the wing's dihedral share fades (TP-2011 fig. 51). Before: the same with the throttle left at cruise: no wing drop, no spin, no plunge; the prop's torque and P factor turn it slowly, which is not a departure. 2026-10-08 (docs/FLIGHTMODEL.md, the stall part 1): flown as the handbook flies a power on stall, the wings held level on the rudder (FAA-H-8083-3C ch. 5); with the slipstream's swirl a tractor turns left there with the rudder left alone. The bands are as they were. The yaw limit is re-derived 2026-10-11 from a spin's definition, autorotation: with the wings inside the bank limit the aircraft only turns, at g tan(bank) / V, so the limit is the turn that bank allows at the mush's speed (31 to 32 deg/s here), where it was 20 deg/s with no source (scripts/slowstick-gates.js S9, docs/FLIGHTMODEL.md).

s10_phugoid.source: the phugoid root of the four state longitudinal model where the gate flies it, hands off at 75 percent with the elevator neutral: settled at 5.37 m/s climbing at 6.8 deg, derived 6.02 s, zeta 0.296. Re-derived 2026-10-11 on the prop curve FW_SLOWSTICK1180 carries (APC's stand in for GWS's 11 x 8; prop curves, w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e, scripts/slowstick-derive.js through scripts/lib/propcurve.js): was 6.08 trimmed level at the 5.58 m/s cruise, which on the line was the hands off speed as well; on the curve level at 75 percent is 7.41 m/s (8.64 s there) but the neutral elevator still trims about 5.4, so the derivation now trims the gate's own flight. The band the same 0.822 to 1.168 of the derived (was 5.0 to 7.1) Re-derived 2026-10-11 with the prop at the motor law's speed for the stick (propcurve.js electricN, 0.776 at 0.75; the derivation had taken the stick for the speed): derived 6.02 to 6.08, the band in the same proportion, was 4.95 to 7.03.

s11_prop_torque.source: static full throttle, rolling left: ideal disc power 0.033, GWS's electrical figure through a geared can motor 0.057

s12_chop.source: throttle off from cruise, pitch stick neutral: a glide, not a tumble

s13_throw.source: a throw at 6 m/s and cruise throttle with every stick centred, the elevator trimmed for 5.5 m/s: flying level after three seconds, not sinking out of the hand

s14_rest.source: the drawn model at rest, 6.91 deg and 0.1349 m, 25.8 percent on the tail

s15_takeoff.source: Re-derived 2026-10-11 on scripts/lib/liftcurve.js brought up to the plant's sourced model (the wing stalling on its own slope a_w, the tail's share lifting on past it, the finite wing's broadside normal force 1.11 + 0.018 AR of Viterna and Janetzke NASA TM-82944 with B2, where it had the whole aircraft's slope and the infinite plate's 2.0): the roll 2.22 m at 4.55 m/s (was 2.32 m at 4.63), the bands in the same proportions (was 1.67 to 3.55 m, 3.99 to 5.32 m/s). Re-derived 2026-10-11 on the prop curve FW_SLOWSTICK1180 carries (APC's stand in for GWS's 11 x 8; prop curves, w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e, scripts/slowstick-derive.js through scripts/lib/propcurve.js): the roll 2.32 m, was 3.20 m, the distance band the same 0.72 to 1.53 of it (was 2.29 to 4.9), the lift off speed unchanged. Full throttle on grass with every stick centred, from standing: derived 3.20 m and 4.63 m/s, the wing near its stall at the rest attitude; the band the first derivation's in proportion (0.72 to 1.53 of the distance, 0.86 to 1.15 of the speed). Re-derived 2026-10-08 on the plant's curve with CL max at its top and the stalled centre of pressure moving aft from the stall (docs/FLIGHTMODEL.md, scripts/lib/liftcurve.js): the first was 4.9 m and 5.2 m/s, on a curve that peaked at 0.81 of CL max

s16_landing.source: a glide from 3 m at cruise, flared at half a metre: touches at a jog, 1.1 V_s is 4.9 m/s, and comes to rest on three wheels at S14's attitude, no hull

s17_unmoved.source: the five inch's canonical replay hash, the wing's, the Skyhunter's, the Cub's, the Radian's and the Bramor's two recorded flight hashes in Node, all from before the Slow Stick existed (the Radian's and the Bramor's from main's module at be91597). Re-recorded for crash round 4 aero (#59), from its merged build, with the owner's sign-off on the stall after flying it: sky, cub, glider, bramor, bramorChute each cross the stall (docs/STALL-STAGE1.md, npm run stall:crossing); the five inch, the wing and the Slow Stick are unchanged The Radian's re-recorded again for crash round 5 on the lead's decision to take its 6 deg FITTED washout (docs/STALL-STAGE1.md), not on an owner's flight: its recording first differs at 7.778 s, in the stall (npm run stall:crossing). Every recorded flight re-recorded again for aero round 6's fix, the table's rotary derivatives applied in the stability axes, one commit per recording from that build, on the owner's approval of the fix on 2026-09-26: each moves short of the stall as well (docs/STALL-STAGE1.md, Round 6). The fixed wings' hashes were re-recorded on 2026-09-27 when their packs and tanks began to drain, the owner's decision (docs/POWER-STAGE1.md); the five inch's is unchanged. Re-pinned for the prop's slipstream and its gyroscope on every prop (docs/FLIGHTMODEL.md): the recordings flown under power moved; the five inch's is as it was.

s19_thermal.source: a straight pass at 75 percent through the core of the strongest thermal (2.5 m/s, 45 m, plant_wing.c), pitch stick centred: the aircraft rises with the air, w0 (16/15) R / V = 22.4 m at the 5.37 m/s hands off speed, against the same flight in still air; the band is 25 percent, the phugoid and the speed the pass is flown at. Re-derived 2026-10-11 on the prop curve FW_SLOWSTICK1180 carries (APC's stand in for GWS's 11 x 8; prop curves, w35-prop-ctj 562dc785e, scripts/slowstick-derive.js through scripts/lib/propcurve.js): V was the 5.58 m/s cruise, 21.5 m, which on the line was the hands off speed too; the curve takes the cruise to 7.41 but the centred stick still flies about 5.4, so V is now that (was 16.1 to 26.9) Re-derived 2026-10-11 with the prop at the motor law's speed for the stick (propcurve.js electricN, 0.776 at 0.75; the derivation had taken the stick for the speed): derived 22.4 to 22.5, the band in the same proportion, was 16.8 to 28.0.

s18_cross_host.source: the Slow Stick's recorded take off and flight, state trace hash, Node against headless Chrome
